latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Agent Ops Kit: a complete toolkit for production-grade agent monitoring.

- Provides autonomous health monitoring for URLs, TCP ports, and processes.
- Includes automatic service restart and detailed service management.
- Sends Telegram alerts on incidents and recovery, with rate limiting.
- Tracks uptime and key metrics, storing historical records.
- Offers a task board system and flexible orchestrator loop (cron/launchd).
- Easy, scriptable setup with comprehensive configuration options.
